Namespace: [Ankus](/api/ankus/)

Assembly: `Ankus.Runtime.dll`

Owns a row-major PostgreSQL array, preserving up to six dimensions and their lower bounds.
Use nullable value types for SQL NULL elements and nullable annotations for reference elements.
A null array reference represents SQL NULL.

```csharp
public sealed class PgArray<T> : IReadOnlyList<T>, IReadOnlyCollection<T>, IEnumerable<T>, IEnumerable
```

Type parameters:

`T`

A supported scalar element type, such as int?, string, or PgNumeric.

### PgArray(ReadOnlySpan&lt;T&gt;, ReadOnlySpan&lt;int&gt;, ReadOnlySpan&lt;int&gt;)

Copies elements and dimensions. Empty arrays normalize to PostgreSQL's zero-dimensional empty array.

```csharp
public PgArray(ReadOnlySpan<T> values, ReadOnlySpan<int> lengths, ReadOnlySpan<int> lowerBounds = default)
```

Parameters:

`values` — [ReadOnlySpan&lt;T&gt;](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.readonlyspan-1)

The row-major elements; the last subscript varies fastest.

`lengths` — [ReadOnlySpan&lt;int&gt;](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.readonlyspan-1)

Zero through six dimension lengths whose product equals the element count.

`lowerBounds` — [ReadOnlySpan&lt;int&gt;](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.readonlyspan-1)

One lower bound per dimension, or an empty span to use one for every dimension.
